headline: 8 dead in Ashulia lorry fire after gas cylinder blast
summary: Four Pretty Group factories shut down for a day following a fatal explosion in the parking area that killed at least 8 people.
details: At least 8 people were killed after a gas cylinder exploded in a lorry parked in the open parking area of Pretty Group's premises in Jamgora, Ashulia.
The fire broke out in the transport section, which is used for moving goods from the factories. While the vehicles were destroyed, the factory buildings themselves were not damaged.
Four factories—Pretty Composite Textile Ltd, Pretty Composite Garments Ltd, Oxford Colours Ltd, and S Suhi Industrial Park Ltd—remained closed today to assess the situation.
Police confirmed that one body is at Dhaka Medical College Hospital and six others are at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, with five bodies yet to be identified.
Most of the victims are believed to be employees of the factories' transport section. It is unlikely that factory production workers were among the dead as the fire was confined to the parking area.
Savar Upazila Nirbahi Officer Md Saiful Islam stated that the Fire Service and Civil Defence and the Department of Labour will form separate probe committees to investigate the cause.
The upazila administration is assessing the damage, and arrangements are being made to provide pre-compensation to the families of the victims.
caption:
A gas cylinder blast in an Ashulia parking lot kills 8 people.

Four Pretty Group factories shut down in the aftermath.

At least 8 people were killed after a gas cylinder exploded in a lorry parked in the open parking area of Pretty Group's premises in Jamgora, Ashulia.

The fire broke out in the transport section, which is used for moving goods from the factories. While the vehicles were destroyed, the factory buildings themselves were not damaged.

Four factories—Pretty Composite Textile Ltd, Pretty Composite Garments Ltd, Oxford Colours Ltd, and S Suhi Industrial Park Ltd—remained closed today to assess the situation.

Police confirmed that one body is at Dhaka Medical College Hospital and six others are at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, with five bodies yet to be identified.

Most of the victims are believed to be employees of the factories' transport section. It is unlikely that factory production workers were among the dead as the fire was confined to the parking area.

Savar Upazila Nirbahi Officer Md Saiful Islam stated that the Fire Service and Civil Defence and the Department of Labour will form separate probe committees to investigate the cause.

The upazila administration is assessing the damage, and arrangements are being made to provide pre-compensation to the families of the victims.

headline: MP Gazi Nazrul and first wife arrested over second wife’s death
summary: The lawmaker and his first wife are accused of abetting the suicide of Mariyam Khatun, whose body was found hanging in a building in Dhaka.
details: MP Gazi Nazrul Islam and his first wife have been arrested in connection with the death of his second wife, Mariyam Khatun.
caption:
